```{r}
library(geiger)
trait_data <- read.csv("/Users/kylewillard/Downloads/Adelphi/Bio620/AVONET_Sup_Data/AVONET3_BirdTreeTable.csv")
trait_data$Species3 <- gsub(" ","_",trait_data$Species3)
rownames(trait_data) <- trait_data$Species3
chk<-name.check(consensus_tree, trait_data)
cleaned_matched <- treedata(consensus_tree, trait_data, sort = TRUE)
cleaned_matched
trait_data <- as.data.frame(cleaned_matched$data)
name.check(consensus_tree, trait_data)
```





```{r}
library(ape)
library(nlme)
bm <- corBrownian(1, consensus_tree, form = ~ Species3)
bm
trait_data$Beak.Length_Culmen <- as.numeric(
  as.character(trait_data$Beak.Length_Culmen)
)

trait_data$Beak.Depth <- as.numeric(
  as.character(trait_data$Beak.Depth)
)
pgls<-gls(Beak.Length_Culmen~Beak.Depth, data=trait_data, correlation=bm)
summary(pgls)
```
